paite: Huchi in hiaite Kish tapa Saul ziak a akihepmang lai a Ziklag a David kiang a hong paite ahi uh: huchi in kidouna a amah panpih mite mihatte lak ah a-om uhi.
heading: Benjamin Nam A Pan David Zui Masate

paite: Thalte in akigalthuam ua, suangkap leh thalpeu a thalkap ah khut taklam leh veilam azang thei ua; amaute Saul unau, Benjamin a kipan ahi uhi.
Amakaipen Ahiezer ahi, huan Joash, Gibeah mi Shemaah tapate: Azmaveth tapate Jeziel leh Pelet; Berkah, Antoth mi Jehu;
Gibeon mi Ishmaiah, sawmthumte lak a mihat, sawmthumte tung ah; Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan leh Geerath mi Jozabad;
Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah leh Haruph mi Shephatiah;
Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer leh Korahith mi Jashobeam;
Gedor mi Jeroham tapate Joelah leh Zebadiah ahi uh.
Gad mite ahihleh gamdai a kulh ah David lam ah akituamseh ua, mihangsan, kidouna a dia chilsa, lum leh teipi khoih theite; amaitang uh humpinelkaite maitang bang, mual a sazate bang a kin;
heading: David Zuite

paite: Ezer apipen, azom in Obadiah, Eliab athumna;
Mishmannah alina, Jeremiah angana;
Attai agukna, Eliel asagihna;
Johanan agiatna, Elzabad akuana;
Jeremiah asawmna, Makbannai asawm-le-khatna.
Hiai Gad tapate lak ate sepaihte heutute ahi uh: aneupen zakhat toh akikim a, alianpen pen sangkhat toh.
Hiaite Jordan lui piaute tui in atup lai a, akha khatna a kan a paite ahi ua; huchi in phaizang a om tengteng, suahlam leh tumlam tuaktuak, delhzakte ahi uh.
Benjamin leh Judah tate lak a mi, kulh ah David kiang ah ahong uhi.
heading: Benjamin Leh Judah A Kipan David Zuite

paite: Huchi in amaute tuak ding in David apaikhia a, amaute kiang ah, "Hon panpih dia lemna deih a ka kiang a hong na hih ualeh, nou a ding in ka lungtang phankhawm ahi ding; himahleh ka khut ah bangmah hiamgamna a-om kei chih thei a, ka galte a dia kei hon man ding a hong pai na hih uleh, ka pipute uh Pathian in huai en henla, sal hen," achi hi.

Huai lai in sawmthumte lak a amakai lianpenpa, Amasai tung ah kha ahong tung a, "Nang David, Jesse tapa, nang a, nang lam a pang ka hi uh: na kiang ah muanna om henla, nang hon panpih mite kiang ah muanna: na Pathian in lah nang ahon panpih ngal a,” achi hi. Huai lai in David in amaute ana kipahpih a, pawl heutute ding in abawlta hi.

Manasseh a kipan in leng khenkhatte, hong taikhia in kidouna a Saul dou ding a Philistia mite toh hong pai in David lam ah ahong belh ua; himahleh amaute'n amaute apanpih kei uh. Philistia mite toupate'n thu hilh in amah asawlmang ngal ua, i lupente uh lauthawnghuaina ding in, "Saul, heutupa lam ah apukmang ding," chi in.
heading: Manasseh A Kipan David Zuite

paite: Ziklag a David ahoh in, Manasseh a kipan amah lam ah hong puklut a-om ua, Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Elihu, Zilthai, Manasseh a kipan sangkhatte heutute ahi uhi.
Huan galguk bawlte dou ding in David apanpih uh; amau lah mihat hangsante leh sepaih lak a heutute ahi ngal ua.
Sepaih pawl thupi, Pathian sepaih pawl bang a hong hih masiah uh niteng in David kiang ah amah panpih ding in ahong paikhawm uhi.
Hiaite TOUPA thu bang a Saul gam amah a dia bawl dia kidou ding kigalthuamte huaite lupente Hebron a David kiang a hong paite ahi uhi.
heading: David Sepaihte Minkhumna

paite: Judah tate lum leh teipi tawi theite sangguk-le-zagiat, kidou ding a kigalthuam.
Simeon tate ah kidouna ding a, mihat hangsante, sangsagih-le-zakhat.
Levi tate ah sangli-le-zaguk.
ehoiada bel Aaron inkote pipa ahi a, amah toh sangthum-le-zasagih a-om uhi;
Tangval hat hangsan, Zadok leh apa inkote heutu sawmnih-le-nih.
Benjamin tate, Saul unaute, sangthum: amaute lak a thupi penpente Saul inkote lam ah aginom lailai uhi.
Ephraim tate ah singnih-le-zagiat, mihat hangsan, apipute uh inkote a miminthangte.
Manasseh nam kimkhatte singkhat-le-sanggiat, hong a, David kumpipa a bawl dia, min genkhiakte.
Issakar tate, hunte theihsiamna nei mite, Israel in bang ahih dia chih thei ding; amaute lupente zanih ahi uh; huan a-unaute tengteng uh amau thupiak in a-om uhi.
Zebulun a kipan, sepaih pawl kuankhe theite bang, kidouna van chi chih toh kigalthuamsa singnga; kidou ding a kigalthuamsa, lungsim thuah nih nei lou mite.
Naphtali a kipan heutu sangkhat, amaute kiang ah lum leh teipi tawi singthum-le-sangsagih.
Dan mite kidou ding a kigal thuamsa, singnih sanggiat-le-zaguk.
Asher a kipan, sepaih pawl akuankhe thei, kidou ding a kigalthuamsa singli.
Jordan lehlam gal ah, Reuben mite leh Gad mite leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte a kipan, kidouna a ding a kidouna vanzat chi chih toh nuaikhat-le-singnih.

Hiaite tengteng, kidoumi ngen hi in, kidou ding a kigalthuamsa, lungtang bukim toh Hebron ah David, Israel tengteng tung a kumpipa dia bawl ding in ahong pai ua: David kumpipa a bawl ding in Israel dang tengteng in lungkhat apu chiat uhi.
Huchi in huai ah David kiang a, ne leh dawn in, ni thum a-om uh; a-unaute un lah amau a ding in kisakna abawl ngal ua.

Huai ban ah Issakar, Zebulun leh Naphtali tanpha a teng amau kiangnai a omte'n, sabiltungte leh sangawngsaute leh sakol neute leh bawngtalte in tanghou ahon pua ua, an nek ding, theipi gah beute, grep minbomte, uain leh sathau, atam a tam bawngtalte leh belamte: Israel nopsakna thupi ahi.
